name: Domestic Investment Strategic Fund (DIAF)
criteriaNote: Demo criteria: manufacturing projects only. Not the official DIAF guidelines.
description: Federal fund to accelerate domestic investment into high-value, high-tech manufacturing activities.

name: Industry4WRD Intervention Fund
criteriaNote: Demo criteria: manufacturing SMEs adopting IR4.0 tech, capped at RM 500k. Not the official guidelines.
description: Matching fund for manufacturing SMEs to adopt Industry 4.0 technologies and digitalise production.

name: Selangor Smart Manufacturing Grant
criteriaNote: Demo criteria: Selangor-registered manufacturers only. Not the official scheme.
description: State grant for Selangor manufacturers upgrading to automation and smart-factory lines.

name: Penang Industrial Development Fund
criteriaNote: Demo criteria: Penang-registered manufacturers only. Not the official scheme.
description: State fund supporting Penang-based advanced manufacturing and E&E expansion.

name: Cradle CIP Spark
criteriaNote: Demo criteria: early-stage tech startups in services. Not the official CIP criteria.
description: Conditional grant for early-stage technology startups to commercialise innovative products.

name: DAKN 2030 Agro-Processing Upgrade Grant
criteriaNote: Demo criteria: agriculture and agro-processing SMEs. Not the official DAKN fund terms.
description: Grant for agro-food SMEs to upgrade processing lines and adopt modern farming tech.

name: SME Digitalisation Matching Grant
criteriaNote: Demo criteria: any sector, digitalisation spending only. Not the official scheme.
description: Sector-agnostic matching grant for SMEs digitalising operations across any industry.
